note: Colombia: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for 90 days, extendable to 180 in a calendar year (Israel 90 in 180; Canadians pay an entry fee on arrival, not modelled). Everyone else needs a visa, applied for online through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Read from Wikipedia's copy of Migración Colombia's list. Checked on 2026-11-03 against Resolución 5488 de 2022 as amended by Resolución 12189 de 2026, in the Ministry's own compilation: literal A names 98 of the passports held, and Oman, which was added; it restored Israel on the same terms as the rest (a short stay under 90 days, extendable to 180), so Israel's separate 90 in 180 was dropped. Belarus, Hong Kong and Mongolia aren't on literal A (by Article 6 a bilateral agreement may exempt them) and stand on Wikipedia's copy; literal C's conditional exemption (a US or Schengen visa) isn't modelled.
